title: Transition
description: One auditable change to a claim's belief (housamkak v3 §6.6, §8.1) — one line of llm-wiki/states/transitions.jsonl, the append-only ledger of what changed and why. transition_id = tr_ + 12 hex of sha256(observation_id · operation · claim_id), or of sha256(claim_id · decay_update · timestamp) for a decay_update row, which no observation drives. weights is the §7.4 breakdown the updater computed: the inputs to the move travel beside the move, so anyone disputing a probability can see which input to dispute; a decay_update row carries weights null and a decay object in its place. The engine (actor llm-wiki-state/1.1) emits new_claim, support_update, contradiction_update, scope_split, exception_addition, supersession, decay_update, and human_override; promotion, archival, and rejection are reserved for later phases.

observation_id.description: The observation that caused the move; null for operations no observation drives (decay, archival).

related_claim_id.description: The other claim in a two-claim operation: the superseded claim on a supersession, the sibling on a scope split.

weights.description: §7.4 — the confidence dimensions behind the move. null when the operation moved no number (exception_addition, human_override).

observation_strength.description: The product of the four dimensions, clamped.

evidence_weight.description: The signed log-odds move: +ln((1+s)/(1−s)) for support, negative for contradiction.

decay.description: Present only on a decay_update row: the elapsed time, the profile's half-life, the factor 0.5^(elapsed/half_life) applied to log_odds, and the log-odds before and after. fold sets log_odds to log_odds_after and never recomputes the factor.

actor.description: llm-wiki-state/<version> for the updater, human:<name> for an override.

run_id.description: The run that appended this row (spec.md `### Ledger rows`) — run_ + 12 hex of sha256(actor · verb · timestamp · the input hashes · views_before), the same id stamped on the row's states/audit_log.jsonl entry. Optional: absent on every row from Phases 1–5, present on every row Phase 6 on appends.
